::: {.content-visible when-profile="id"}
::: {.callout-warning}
**Tutorial adalah prasyarat wajib untuk Individual Assignment minggu yang sama** - kalau belum dikerjakan, Individual Assignment tidak akan dinilai. Deadline Tutorial adalah hari Rabu itu sendiri (tidak harus selesai persis saat sesi lab, boleh dilanjutkan sampai akhir hari Rabu); deadline Individual Assignment adalah Senin minggu berikutnya. Lihat tanggal lengkap tiap minggu di [halaman Jadwal](../index.qmd#jadwal-semester).
:::

1. Setiap minggu, Senin adalah kelas materi dan Rabu adalah sesi lab tutorial. Tutorial harus diselesaikan paling lambat hari Rabu itu - tidak wajib rampung persis di jam sesi lab, boleh dilanjutkan sendiri sampai akhir hari.
2. Tutorial **tidak dinilai** secara langsung, tapi menjadi **prasyarat wajib** untuk Individual Assignment minggu yang sama - kalau Tutorial minggu itu belum diselesaikan, Individual Assignment yang bersangkutan **tidak akan dinilai**, meskipun sudah dikumpulkan.
3. Mahasiswa dapat bertanya kepada asisten dosen selama jam sesi lab.
4. Individual Assignment dirilis Senin (minggu yang sama dengan Tutorial-nya), dengan tenggat waktu Senin minggu **berikutnya** - jadi lebih lama dari deadline Tutorial-nya sendiri (lihat menu Tugas).
:::
::: {.content-visible when-profile="en"}
::: {.callout-warning}
**A Tutorial is a mandatory prerequisite for that same week's Individual Assignment** - if it hasn't been completed, the Individual Assignment won't be graded. A Tutorial's deadline is that same Wednesday (it doesn't have to be finished exactly during the lab session, just by the end of that day); its Individual Assignment's deadline is the following Monday. See exact dates for every week on the [Schedule page](../index.qmd#semester-schedule).
:::

1. Every week, Monday is the lecture and Wednesday is the tutorial lab session. Tutorials must be completed by that Wednesday at the latest - not necessarily finished exactly during the lab hours, just by the end of that day.
2. Tutorials are **not graded** directly, but are a **mandatory prerequisite** for that same week's Individual Assignment - if that week's Tutorial hasn't been completed, the corresponding Individual Assignment **will not be graded**, even if submitted.
3. Students may ask teaching assistants questions during the lab session.
4. Individual Assignments are released on Monday (the same week as their Tutorial), with a deadline the **following** Monday - later than the Tutorial's own deadline (see the Assignments menu).
:::
